title: Shift Solenoid E Malfunction
fullDescription:
Transmission shift solenoid E is malfunctioning, causing shifts to be harsh, missed, or in the wrong gear.

May trigger limp mode to protect the transmission.

fixSteps.title: Scan and pan drop
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect ATF and pan for debris.
